hooks.command: f="@QASS_CONFIG@/lessons.md"; if [ -s "$f" ]; then echo "Lessons from the owner ($f):"; head -c 8000 "$f"; [ "$(wc -c < "$f")" -gt 8000 ] && printf '\n%s\n' "(cut at 8000 characters: the rest of $f is not loaded)"; fi; echo "qass: your skill is @QASS_DATA@/.claude/skills/qass (its scripts too), your notes @QASS_DATA@/memory.md, your scratch @QASS_DATA@/scratch/. After a wake or a resume the fleet watcher is not running; start it again (Start, step 3) from that dir before anything else."; true
